text:
Rae (Design): flagged during usability: the roles matrix header is crowded. SSO toggle sits far right; users miss it. Also audit search feels buried under the main nav.
Eli (Product): hmm. do we shift SSO toggle into the role details flyout or move it into the top row? tradeoffs?
Rae (Design): top-row placement would be more discoverable for org admins. proposal: a slim SSO pill in the table header (left of filters) with tooltip "SSO status: on/off".
Sam (Eng): technically fine. header pill can call /orgs/:id/sso-status on hover if we want live state. prefer client-side cached state to avoid spikes.
Priya (PM): key requirement: toggling SSO in the matrix should show the audit event and link to it. customers get confused when the change isn't obvious.
June (A11y): accessibility concerns: header pill must be keyboard reachable and readable by screen readers. Provide aria-pressed for toggle, aria-label like "SSO: enabled for org" and a visible focus ring.
Rae (Design): noted. also adding small search box in the roles header: "Search audit by actor or action" which pre-filters the audit panel when opened.
Sam (Eng): search in header -> emits event to audit store. We'll implement debounced query and reuse audit endpoint: /audit?query=...&role=... If no role, it becomes org-wide.
Eli (Product): microcopy question: label the SSO control "SSO" or "Single sign-on"? shorter fits header but might be unclear to new admins.
June (A11y): use visible short label + aria-describedby linking to help text: "Single sign-on status and controls." Screenreader will get the full phrase.
Priya (PM): rollout: feature flag 'roles_header_sso_audit_search' -> 7% canary. Metrics: header pill clicks, toggle clutches, search-to-audit conversions, and support mentions about SSO events.
Rae (Design): UI notes: contrast of pill needs >=4.5:1 against header background. hover increases contrast and shows a chevron to indicate a panel. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123/roles-header-compact-v2 (frame 3).
Sam (Eng): Jira: INC-4021. Plan: 1d spike to wire header events, 2d implement pill + search UI, 1d integrate with audit deep-link, 1d QA. Will gate behind flag.
June (A11y): checklist I'll run: keyboard nav order, aria-pressed, aria-describedby, live region announcement for audit jumps. Also color contrast check.
Eli (Product): ok team. actions: Sam - ticket & PR, Rae - update mocks + annotation, June - accessibility test cases, Priya - metric dashboard + canary config.
figma-bot: Updated file 'roles-header-compact-v2' at 2810005620.
